description: This file defines the ProjectUserRepository class, which manages database operations related to project-user relationships, including creating new entries and deleting entries by ID.

classes.name: ProjectUserRepository
classes.description: A repository class for managing project-user association records in the database, extending base MySQL repository functionality.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Inserts a new project-user association record into the database with specified project and user IDs.

methods.name: deleteById
methods.description: Deletes a project-user association record from the database based on its unique ID.
